answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. This economic barrier makes creating a fable identity costly, as each new node must anchor its legitimacy in burned capital. Like a quartz oscillator stabilizing a signal, this ensures deterministic throughput. Attackers attempting to flood the network would deplete their own treasury, effectively wrecking their assets against the fiscal reef of the protocol.
